name: ibis-office-web
description: Build tooling for the browser version of ibisOffice (www/).

scripts.test:web: npm run build:font-engine && tsc --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom,dom.iterable --strict --skipLibCheck www/font-coverage.ts www/wasm-loader.ts www/font-loader.ts www/dynamic-fonts.ts worker/font-service.ts worker/sorane-gateway.ts worker/wasm-delivery.ts && node --test test/web/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:fonts: npm run build:font-engine && tsc --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom,dom.iterable --strict --skipLibCheck www/font-coverage.ts www/wasm-loader.ts www/font-loader.ts www/dynamic-fonts.ts worker/font-service.ts && node --test test/web/font-*.test.mjs
scripts.check:worker: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareEnv && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json
